We can use a known result: > **Theorem (Erdős–Pósa type, or related to degree conditions in induced subgraphs):**  
> For any integer $ d $, the **maximum number of edges** in a graph on $ n $ vertices that **does not contain a vertex-induced subgraph where all vertices have degree at least $ d $** is:
> $$
> \left\lfloor \frac{(d-1)n}{2} \right\rfloor
> $$

\left\lfloor \frac{(5-1) \cdot 10}{2} \right\rfloor = \left\lfloor \frac{4 \cdot 10}{2} \right\rfloor = \left\lfloor 20 \right\rfloor = 20
$$
